conversation.text:
Police: Why do you remember the time so precisely?
Respondent: There’s a call record on my phone.
Respondent: When I go out with the children, I never leave them alone to go somewhere else.
Respondent: But... I received a phone call.
Respondent: Usually, hardly anyone calls me in the afternoon.
Respondent: So I might have been a bit flustered at that moment.
Respondent: I wanted to find a quieter place to take the call,
Respondent: so I went into the corridor of a nearby building...
Respondent: The call only lasted five minutes, and I looked away for less than five minutes.
Respondent: Because the call wasn’t finished, I came back, but by then Xiyuan was already gone.
